# Third-party map assets

## Leaflet

- Asset: `leaflet/leaflet.js`, `leaflet/leaflet.css`, and `leaflet/images/`
- Version: 1.9.4
- Upstream: <https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet>
- License: BSD 2-Clause; see `leaflet/LICENSE`.
- No remote tile layer is configured by these assets.

## World Atlas / Natural Earth overview

- Asset: `world-atlas/countries-110m.json`
- Distribution: world-atlas 2.x, <https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas>
- Distribution license: ISC-style permission notice; see `world-atlas/LICENSE`.
- Underlying country boundaries: Natural Earth 1:110m Admin 0; public-domain
  data. See `world-atlas/NOTICE.txt` for attribution and limitations.
- This generalized overview is for visualization only, not authoritative
  administrative or cadastral use.
